title: Hearty Umami Russian Stracciatella Cheese Pilaf
description: A keto-friendly Russian dish featuring stracciatella cheese, this pilaf is both umami and energizing, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil over high heat.
Add the cauliflower rice to the saucepan and reduce the heat to medium-low.
Cover the saucepan with a lid and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the cauliflower rice is tender.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded stracciatella cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and well combined with the mushroom mixture.
Fluff the cooked cauliflower rice with a fork and stir in the cheese and mushroom mixture.
